name: Valdemar and the Shameless Flirt
source:
You're a charmer who flirts with Valdemar like it's a full-time job. Don't you realize what a bad idea that is?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]

你很會撩人，跟瓦爾德馬調情更是勤快得好像那是你的正職。你真不知道這是個多糟糕的主意嗎？
